text:
maria_sales: Heads up 1: FinBank is asking if we can run a 2-week POC with all processing strictly in EU or APAC depending on their customer segment. They want: subprocessor list per region, BYOK options, and a statement that no PII will leave the region. Need something succinct for their security team.

rachel_presales: Ill draft. Clarify: they want a single POC that covers both regions (split traffic) or two separate region-pinned POCs?

maria_sales: Prefer two separate region-pinned POCs (one EU one APAC). Theyll run EU traffic to eu-central-1 and APAC to ap-northeast-1.

tom_infra: Technical note: we can tenant-pin two separate tenants for the POC. Each tenants compute/storage stays in region. Control plane remains hosted by default (control signals cross regions) unless they choose Private control plane.

nate_security: Important: even with tenant pinning, third-party telemetry or alerting services may route to multi-region endpoints. For EU POC we can restrict Datadog and S3 log buckets to eu-central-1 endpoints, and for APAC to ap-northeast-1. Cloudflare logs are tricky  we can restrict log forwarding config.

ellie_legal: We can provide the subprocessors list per region. Will redact contact emails but include vendor name, role, and region. Flag: BYOK requires Dedicated or Private for key-access integration; otherwise we provide key custody attestation and HKP proof. Any contractual DPA changes will add ~2 weeks.

rachel_presales: Draft bullets to send customer: 1) Region pinning: compute+storage remain in chosen region. 2) Control plane: hosted by default; Private option available. 3) Subprocessors: attached list by region. 4) BYOK: available on Dedicated/Private; attestation otherwise. 5) Block-cross-region: we can enforce deny_egress flag in POC but full enforcement (telemetry/backup) needs SOW. 6) Timeline: diagram+subprocessors in 48h; enforcement SOW ~5 business days.

tom_infra: Example routing snippet we can include: ```
region: eu-central-1
tenant_pin: true
deny_egress: true  # POC mode: block outbound to other regions
control_plane: hosted
byok_allowed: false
```

nate_security: Change byok_allowed to "true only with Dedicated/Private" in the customer doc. Also add a short paragraph on what we consider "processing" (inference & storage) vs "control" (telemetry, billing signals).

ellie_legal: I'll prepare DPA language and the subprocessor table. Also add a note on lawful requests: vendor subprocessors follow our contractual process; jurisdictional legal process may still apply.

ops-bot: Reminder: ops follow-up ticket #POC-789 created and assigned to tom_infra.

maria_sales: Great. Rachel, send the one-pager to the FinBank security contact and cc legal. Mention we'll follow up with network diagrams and a priced Dedicated BYOK option within 72h.
rachel_presales: On it. I'll post the draft in #sales-drafts for review in 30m.

maria_sales: Thanks all.
